You wake inside the felt tent to the bitter sweetness of dung smoke — argal, dried sheep and horse pats layered into the central iron stove — and the sour-milk damp of the airag skin swinging from the door-frame, punched by every passer-by to keep it churning. highland_steppe_corridor.title: religion.sacred_register.kheshkai_harmony
highland_steppe_corridor.summary: Kheshkai shamans use vowel-harmony as a binding grammar: an oath in perfect harmony binds; a broken-harmony oath is a non-oath, hearable-but-ineffectual. The system is oral-only (no scribal class), master-to-apprentice on horseback, and identified by "hearing-gift" (often perfect-pitch individuals). Each generation renegotiates orthodoxy.

highland_relay.title: economy.civ.qollari
highland_relay.summary: Qollari sells altitude. Its highland exports are high in value and low in bulk: medicinal bark, the cinchona-analog fever-bark that no lowland can grow, rare dyestuffs of the cochineal kind, and the fine camelid fiber, vicuna-analog above 3,800 meters, that constitutes a wool monopoly the lowlands cannot touch. To these the cloud-states add structural timber from the wetter slopes, silver, gold, processed tin-bronze…

The sabkha slabs cut from its salt-flats, the Taghaza and Taoudenni analog of Veydria, are the most universally accepted inland commodity money on the continent, and the salt itself is the northern anchor of the continental spine against Ndjadi grain. Around the salt, the drylands yield natron, dates, lode silver…

scribal_ladder.title: magic.system.ndjadi_wazahaki
scribal_ladder.summary: Etymology: waza (skill) + haki (truth, justice). "Craft of truth" — the sacred register of the Ndjadi scribal colleges.

scribal_ladder.title: religion.sacred_register.ndjadi_tier_prefixes
scribal_ladder.summary: Ndjadi magic is the strongest Vedic analog in Veydria: speaking correctly IS prayer, a misapplied prefix is not a grammar error but a cosmological miscategorization with consequences. The three-tier prefix system (ra-/ka-/nga-) simultaneously classifies cosmological rank, determines liturgical validity, and gates institutional authority.

scribal_ladder.title: religion.pilgrimage.scribal_ladder
scribal_ladder.summary: The Aethelian's main religious-and-trade axis: Ndjadi habal-copyists undertake a "correction pilgrimage" to Irrah pyramid-necropolises to collate their sacred prefixes against pre-reform attestations. The route strings through Aethelian entrepot copy-houses, crosses Irrah caravan lanes under Qalībin path-finder protection, and returns with necropolis-blessed amulet-bound copies.

scribal_ladder.title: religion.reform.qalibin_naturalist_schism
scribal_ladder.summary: The quietist creed has drifted over two generations into a full naturalist reading: the Five Waters are hydrological categories, not sacred persons; the water-scholar's job is empirical hydrology dressed in ritual register. The splinter faction -- the Unnamed-Water school (qalib al-ma' al-majhul) -- argues this openly.
